verdict_meaning: pass = every validity check holds; it judges nothing about which forecast is better

rule.score: mean over the two folds of each fold's mean_abs_shape_error on its 396 validation holds (equal weights: both folds hold 396)
rule.tie: scores rounded to 3 decimals (0.001 score units, 0.16% of the admitted fit's 0.6328 per-hold error on B1E_end in refit_check.json); among the candidates with the lowest rounded score the largest L0 is selected (the most weight on the admitted coefficients)
rule.rejection: no candidate is returned when the selected L0's mean_abs_shape_error is not lower than the admitted fit's on the same validation holds in both folds; the assessment then still reports every number

units.shape_error: hand-shape score units: mean over the 10 finger handles and 3 axes of (wrist-relative position error cm / 1.8)^2 plus mean over handles of (orientation error deg / 11)^2; 0 = at the remembered pose
units.angle_error: degrees, mean over holds and 44 hinges
